posts.text: Executive Summary Overview and Market Position VSSL - Supermarket of special steel - vision for the next 10 year VSSL steel has been in existence for over 50 years, however in 2010 it was demerged from Vardhman Textiles into a separate standalone listed company. When demerged the steel business was an okayish business, post listing the first AR mentions focus shifting to low volume critical applications for automotive industry where competition was less. In 2019, Aichi (Toyota’s leading supplier for special steel) entered the company with 11% stake, with an objective of making VSSL as a vendor…
